mgmt_bio.text: She became president and CEO in October 2014 and has served as chair and CEO since February 2022, also sitting on the company's board. In her current role she has led AMD's transformation into a global leader in high performance computing and a key supplier of advanced AI chips. On October 12, 2026 she gave the opening keynote at the OCP Global Summit in San Jose, outlining AMD's open, full-stack infrastructure for agentic AI. She was elected chair of the Semiconductor Industry Association board in November 2025.

thesis_pillars.text: AMD's data center business has become the core earnings engine, with second quarter 2026 segment revenue of $6.7 billion, up 107% year-over-year on demand for EPYC processors and Instinct GPUs, now 58% of total revenue versus 42% a year earlier. Anchor AI customers give multi-year visibility: OpenAI agreed to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs, with the first 1 gigawatt of Instinct MI450 starting in the second half of 2026, alongside a partnership with Anthropic covering up to two gigawatts of Instinct GPUs. Server CPU share gains continue, with server revenue expected to grow more than 70% in 2027 off a higher base. Mix shift is lifting profitability, as gross margin reached 56% in the second quarter of 2026, up over 200 basis points year-over-year.
